queries.query: large language model OR LLM "network configuration" misconfiguration hallucination error "network" OR "NetOps"
queries.rationale: Capture empirical and analytic work documenting LLM failures (hallucinations, incorrect configs, unsafe suggestions) specifically in network-configuration or NetOps contexts.
Find literature on mapping operator intent / NL to concrete network configurations and how LLMs are used for that translation.
Survey architectural mitigations where generation is followed by verification and repair; key for guarded NetOps workflows.

queries.query: network verification Batfish Veriflow Anteater "formal verification" "network configuration" SMT model checking
queries.rationale: Locate deterministic verification tools and formal methods applied to network configs (Batfish, Veriflow, Anteater, SMT approaches) to assess integration with LLM outputs.
Discover existing benchmark suites and datasets used to evaluate LLMs/AIOps in networking; assess coverage and limitations.

queries.query: ecological validity OR representativeness "network datasets" synthetic topologies Mininet NS-3 emulator "NetOps evaluation"
queries.rationale: Identify critiques and studies on how representative common datasets/simulators are of real NetOps workloads and failure modes.

queries.query: adversarial prompt OR adversarial attack "LLM" "network configuration" fuzzing robustness "prompt injection"
queries.rationale: Find work on how adversarial inputs or prompt-injection lead LLMs to produce harmful or incorrect NetOps actions and defenses.

queries.query: agentic agent OR autonomous agent "LLM" "network operations" "autonomous NetOps" LangChain ReAct tool-using agents
queries.rationale: Survey neighbouring research on agentic LLM workflows, orchestration frameworks, and their application to NetOps automation.

queries.query: tool-augmented LLM "API calls" "network device" NETCONF YANG NAPALM Ansible "LLM"
queries.rationale: Identify integrations of LLMs with device APIs, configuration-management tools, and orchestration frameworks to understand practical deployment patterns.
Find methods and metrics used to evaluate whether generated configs meet connectivity, policy, security, or performance objectives.
Locate literature on model uncertainty, calibration, and detection of untrustworthy LLM outputs relevant to signaling operator uncertainty in NetOps.

queries.query: human-in-the-loop operator oversight "LLM" NetOps explainability auditability "human oversight"
queries.rationale: Survey methods that incorporate operator validation, explainability, and audit trails to mitigate automated NetOps risks.

queries.rationale: Neighbouring fields where LLMs synthesize configurations or code may offer transferable methods, evaluation practices, and failure analyses.
source_preferences: industry case studies with open artifacts

queries.query: network configuration datasets public corpus "router config" "switch config" "public" dataset "Batfish corpus"
queries.rationale: Locate publicly available corpora of real or realistic network configs for evaluation and reproducibility.

queries.query: standards NETCONF YANG RFC "network configuration protocol" operational best practices "IETF"
queries.rationale: Collect standards and operational practices to ground evaluation criteria and realistic constraints on generated configs.

inclusion_criteria: Primary sources (peer-reviewed papers, arXiv preprints with full text, theses) with verifiable metadata (DOI, arXiv ID, venue, year).
Empirical studies that provide methods, metrics, datasets, or code, or refer to reproducible tools (Batfish, Mininet, NS-3, public repos).
Benchmarks, datasets, or tool papers that describe data generation, task definitions, and evaluation procedures.
Standards, RFCs, and protocol specifications relevant to network configuration and management (NETCONF, YANG, IETF RFCs).
Works published from ~2015–2026, with emphasis on 2020–2026 for LLM and agentic advances; include earlier foundational networking-verification literature as needed.
Technical industry whitepapers or vendor documentation only when they include reproducible technical detail, links to code/data, or standards references.
exclusion_criteria: Short social-media posts, non-technical marketing material, press releases, or blog posts without primary evidence or links to artifacts.
Sources that cannot be verified (no DOI/arXiv ID, no stable URL, or paywalled without accessible metadata) unless a verified preprint or official tech spec exists.
Opinion pieces or user Q&A without empirical or reproducible content (e.g., unreferenced forum threads).
Works outside the Generative AI / LLMs for NetOps topic family or that only tangentially mention networking without substantive technical detail.
Duplicate records or iterative non-substantive versions of the same report (keep the canonical/most complete version).
date_rationale: Focus on 2020–2026 to capture rapid LLM/agentic advances and applied studies; include relevant foundational networking-verification and benchmarking literature from ~2015 onward to ensure methods and tools (Batfish, Veriflow, Mininet, NS-3) are covered. Recent preprints (2023–2026) are prioritized for state-of-the-art mitigations and agentic workflows.
